DROP TABLE IF EXISTS t_usertopoview CASCADE;

CREATE TABLE t_usertopoview (
   cuserindex int NOT NULL,
   cviewid serial,
   cname varchar(60),
   cmemo varchar(60),
   cbkgimagepath varchar(60),
   ctype int NOT NULL,
   creservedint int,
   creserved varchar(1),
   CONSTRAINT pk_usertopoview_viewid PRIMARY KEY (cviewid)
)
tablespace unmdb_space
distributed masteronly
;

cviewid,cuserindex ASC,cname ASC
);

#!/bin/bash
date
basepath=$(cd `dirname $0` ; pwd )
tmppath="$basepath/../tmp/cmake/pas"
makedir -p temppath
echo "basepath=$basepath"
echo "temp pas dir is $tmppath"
set UNM_NO_PAUSE=1

IB_CONSOLE=`which ib_console`
echo "IB_CONSOLE=$IB_CONSOLE"

echo ${UNM_BUILD_CNT:=8}
echo "UNM_BUILD_CNT is $UNM_BUILD_CNT"

built_type=Debug
echo "built_type=$built_type"
cd $basepath
bash $basepath/cmake_create_all_unm_makes_with_binary_platform.sh $built_type
ret=$?
if [ $ret -ne 0 ];then
    echo "cmake failed! exit = $ret"
    date
    exit $ret
fi

cd $tmppath 
if [ -n "$UNM_BUILD_WITH_IB" -a -n "$IB_CONSOLE" ]; then
	echo "ib_console -d1 make -j 160"
	ib_console -d1 make -j 160
else
	echo "make -j $UNM_BUILD_CNT"
	make -j $UNM_BUILD_CNT
fi

ret=$?
if [ $ret -ne 0 ];then
    echo "build failed! exit = $ret"
    date
    exit $ret
fi

if [ -d ../../../UNM2000/pas/bin ]; then
	rm -rfv ../../../UNM2000/pas/bin
fi

mkdir -p ../../../UNM2000/pas/bin
chmod 777 ../../../UNM2000/pas/bin
cp ./lib/*.* ../../../UNM2000/pas/bin
cp ./bin/* ../../../UNM2000/pas/bin



#if [ -z "$UNM_BUILD_CNT" ]; then
#        echo "UNM_BUILD_CNT is empty, default is 4"
#        make -j 4
#else
#        echo "UNM_BUILD_CNT is $UNM_BUILD_CNT"
#        make -j $UNM_BUILD_CNT
#fi
#make -j 16 
date

# Android kernel
## Compilation
The Android kernel source code is located in the `BST-C1200-LINUX-SDK-Vx.x.x.x-Release/opensource_code` directory as `kernel_android_xxxxxxxxx.tar.gz`. Refer to the [SDK installation](../../quickstart_en/sdk_userguide/sdk-install.md) section for instructions on installing container image dependencies. After setting up the FDK, DDK, and SDK container development environment, copy the source code archive into the container and execute the following commands to compile:

```shell
source /opt/bstos/linux-25/environment-setup-aarch64-bst-linux
./make_c1200_android.sh
```

The generated image, dtb, and defconfig files are located at:

```shell
build/arch/arm64/boot/Image
build/arch/arm64/boot/dts/bst/bstc1200-ivi.dtb
arch/arm64/configs/bstc1200_ivi_defconfig
```

**Note: The image generated here is only the Android kernel image. To generate a complete IVI system image, you need to download the Android code from the developer website and copy the three generated files to the corresponding locations in the Android code project for image compilation.**
